info.title: API.SH: Unsplash
info.description: The Unsplash API from API.SH: public Unsplash data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An Unsplash collection (`collection`: title, description, owner, total photos, dates, tags) and its photos. Each photo: `id`, `slug`, `url`, `description`, `alt_description`, `width`, `height`, `color`, `blur_hash`, `asset_type`, `plus` (Unsplash+ licence), `free`, `likes`, `image` (raw, full, regular, small, thumb links), `author`, `created_at`, `promoted_at` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/unsplash-collection

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Collection id (e.g. `1065976`) or its unsplash.com/collections/ link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Photos (or illustrations) on Unsplash (unsplash.com) for keywords, with every filter of the search page: orientation, colour, sort (relevant or newest), licence (free or Unsplash+) and type. Each photo: `id`, `slug`, `url`, `description`, `alt_description`, `width`, `height`, `color`, `blur_hash`, `asset_type`, `plus` (Unsplash+ licence), `free`, `likes`, `image` (raw, full, regular, small, thumb links), `author`, `created_at`, `promoted_at` and `raw`. Also `total` and `total_pages`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/unsplash-search

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: black_and_white, black, white, yellow, orange, red, purple, magenta, green, teal, blue.

parameters.name: license
parameters.description: `free` (free to use) or `plus` (Unsplash+ only); default both.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (default 1; 20 results a page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
